title: SSO connectors: IdP behavior, edge cases, and troubleshooting playbook
creator: Emma Chen
description:
Summary:
This ticket captures IdP-specific compatibility notes and a troubleshooting playbook for our SAML SSO connectors (Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace/GCP SSO, Ping Identity). The goal is to document deterministic behavior differences, required configuration knobs for RBAC v2 and audit logging, and a runbook for on-call and solutions engineers to resolve customer onboarding failures without escalating to infra.

Background:
We continue to see recurring support cases where customers report failed SSO logins, missing RBAC mappings, or incomplete audit trail events that are caused by subtle IdP defaults (nameID formats, attribute naming, cert rotation cadence, signature algorithms, and SCIM vs SAML provisioning interactions). This ticket produces the canonical compatibility notes, a troubleshooting matrix, test cases, and admin docs to be surfaced in the support playbook and the developer console configuration UI hints.

Out-of-scope:
- Deep SCIM provisioning implementation changes (separate ticket ENG-18002)
- Kerberos/NTLM or non-SAML federation methods
acceptance_criteria:
1) A single document exists that lists IdP-specific required settings for Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, and Ping, including: ACS URL, SP EntityID expectations, accepted NameID formats, required attribute names for RBAC v2 (email, groups, admin flag), recommended signature algorithms, and recommended certificate rotation strategy.
2) Troubleshooting matrix covers at least 12 common failure modes (e.g., time skew, missing attributes, signature mismatch, encrypted assertions, unexpected RelayState).
3) Test plan with automated integration checks for each IdP (happy path + 3 failure scenarios) is authored and attached.
4) Console UI hint text and admin-facing docs are drafted and linked in this ticket.
5) On-call runbook created with clear escalation path and sample logs to search in our audit stream.
6) Security review sign-off noted in the ticket metadata.
test_plan:
Automated tests:
- For each IdP (Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, Ping): create a test tenant/service app and run 1) SP-initiated login (HTTP-POST) 2) IdP-initiated login 3) Logout flow. Verify RBAC v2 role mapping via SAML attributes and that the audit event 'sso.login' contains assertion_id, issuer, principal_email, mapping_result.
- Failure scenarios per IdP: missing 'email' attribute, groups list empty, assertion signed with RSA-SHA1, certificate expired, clock skew 10 minutes. Ensure we produce clear error codes (SAML-ERR-ATTR-MISSING, SAML-ERR-SIG, SAML-ERR-CLOCK).
Manual tests:
- Walkthrough with sample Okta tenant covering admin consent screens and metadata URL change, confirm UI hints are accurate.
- Verify SCIM provisioning interplay: create user via SCIM and ensure SAML login maps to the existing user rather than creating a duplicate.
rollout_plan:
1) Merge docs PR into internal 'security-playbooks' repo.
2) Ship console hint text behind a feature flag and release to canary (5% of accounts) for 48 hours.
3) Run automated integration tests against IdP test tenants.
4) Flip feature flag and publish support playbook.
5) Communicate to Solutions Engineering and Support with sample debug commands and logs to capture.
rollback_plan:
1) Revert console hint feature flag if we observe incorrect or confusing guidance reported by customers.
2) Re-open automated test failures and block release until fixed.
3) Patch documentation defects in a hotfix PR and re-deploy the docs site.
troubleshooting_matrix:
Format: [Symptom] -> [Likely root causes by IdP] -> [Immediate checks] -> [Fix steps]
1) 'Invalid signature' -> OKTA: cert rotation without metadata refresh; AZURE: response signed with RSA-SHA1 by legacy apps; GOOGLE: unexpected alg mismatch. Checks: fetch IdP metadata URL, compare cert thumbprint, inspect SignatureAlgorithm in SAMLResponse. Fix: refresh metadata in console, advise IdP admin to enable SHA256.
2) 'Missing email attribute' -> ALL IdPs: attribute mapping differs (okta 'email', azure 'http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/emailaddress', google 'email'). Checks: decode assertion, inspect AttributeStatement. Fix: update application/claim mapping in IdP, or add alternative attribute names to our mapping config.
3) 'Groups not present' -> OKTA: Need 'Groups' attribute in app mapping; AZURE: must enable 'GroupClaims' and handle pagination; PING: group filters may exclude nested groups. Checks: inspect assertion for GroupAttribute/GroupMembership. Fix: enable group claim, adjust group filters or configure SCIM to sync groups.
4) 'User duplicates created' -> Cause: SCIM provisioning enabled and SAML NameID differs (e.g., immutable id vs email). Checks: compare scim.externalId and SAML NameID/email. Fix: prefer externalId canonicalization, update provisioning settings.
5) 'Logout fails' -> Cause: IdP does not support SP-initiated Single Logout or expects different endpoint binding. Checks: verify SingleLogoutService endpoints in metadata. Fix: enable proper binding or fall back to local session invalidation and audit event noting incomplete IdP logout.
